title: Setup-paused operational scouts matched by MCP activity log instead of null user
answers: Why are operational scouts like inbox validation still paused after running the resume command?
Why does resume_setup_paused_operational_scouts match zero rows for paused scouts?
How does PostHog identify scout pauses made by the setup flow versus manual user pauses?
body:
Symptom: Operational scouts such as inbox validation stay paused after setup, their report checks do not run, and resume_setup_paused_operational_scouts selects zero rows.
Root cause: products/signals/backend/scout_harness/config_registry.py:setup_paused_operational_configs filtered for status_changed_by__isnull=True, but setup-flow pauses ran over MCP on the user's OAuth session so status_changed_by stamped the user.
Fix pattern: Identify automated setup pauses by joining ActivityLog within a 10-second window (_SETUP_PAUSE_LOG_WINDOW) of status_changed_at for client = 'mcp' instead of requiring an unassigned status_changed_by.
Constraints: Only applies when mutations produce ActivityLog records; manual user pauses made through MCP will also match unless constrained by --max-gap-seconds.
applies: Operational scout configuration resumption and setup-pause detection in products/signals
says: Inbox validation scout remains paused after completing initial product setup flow
Resume command fails to unpause operational monitoring scouts configured during onboarding
Automated inspection scouts stay paused after setup wizard finishes connecting integrations
Operational health checks do not resume automatically following initial account configuration
